verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Netlify lets users prompt AI agents from the dashboard to fix, update, and ship code using project context (netlify-docs-21). That is in-product AI acting on project data, but it is code changes, not insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. Netlify also offers observability and analytics (netlify-docs-17), but nothing shows AI applied to them. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights over analytics or deploy data, proactive AI suggestions, detailed docs for the dashboard agent feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
